Top Roofing and Contracting, a family-owned and -operated business based in Kernersville, NC, has quickly become known for reliability and quality in the roofing industry. When Peyton, the company's founder, wanted to elevate his new business's online visibility and streamline operations back in 2020, he turned to digital solutions to ensure his venture's success.

Background Information

Founded in 2019 on the principles of honesty and exceptional service, Top Roofing and Contracting has always prioritized customer satisfaction and durable roofing solutions. As a roofing business in a competitive market, establishing a robust online presence and efficient business processes was crucial for Peyton to differentiate his offerings and manage projects effectively.

The Challenge

Despite their commitment to quality and customer service, Peyton and his team faced challenges in managing their growing business. They needed a way to enhance online visibility to attract more customers and implement an effective system to handle the operational aspects of the business efficiently.

Our Solution: Automated Efficiency with Charlie Company’s Business Management Platform

To address these challenges, a multi-faceted digital strategy was employed, focusing on both enhancing online presence and streamlining business operations.

1. Website Design + SEO

A professionally designed website was created, optimized with local roofing-related keywords to improve search engine rankings. This ensured that potential customers could easily find Top Roofing and Contracting when searching for reliable roofing services in Kernersville.

2. Scheduling

An online scheduling feature was integrated into the website, allowing customers to book appointments 24/7. This not only enhanced customer convenience but also ensured that Peyton and his team did not miss out on potential business opportunities outside of regular working hours.

3. Estimates & Invoices

The platform also enabled the team to quickly send accurate estimates, facilitating faster deal closures. With the invoicing and billing features, the business has processed over $1 million in customer payments so far, streamlining the financial aspect of his operations.

The Results: Robust Growth and Streamlined Operations

Implementing Charlie Company’s business management platform proved transformative for Top Roofing and Contracting. The local SEO efforts significantly boosted the company’s online presence, drawing more customers to their website. The online scheduling widget, coupled with the invoicing and payment features, allowed the team to manage their business operations seamlessly from initial appointment inquiries to final payments.

Since the adoption of these digital tools in 2020, Top Roofing and Contracting has seen substantial business growth.

Conclusion

For Top Roofing and Contracting, digital integration was more than just a modern necessity; it was a strategic move that catalyzed business growth and operational efficiency. Peyton’s proactive approach in partnering with Charlie Company Media enabled his business to thrive by maximizing digital tools to their full potential.
